basis.artifact_inspection: Existing protected-Racket audit, test reports, and exported file bytes; no broad test repeat.

limits: This source-specific review is not owner acceptance, training admission, or a universal identifiability proof. No source, approval, or owner record was modified.

observations.assessment: The filtered nonzero sequence determines both retained values and padding length. Packing consumes both; direction selects rows/columns and the destination edge. No inert or metadata-only direction branch.

Grid validation admits exact integer colors on rectangles of side 1..30. Nonempty line dimensions make transpose safe; empty filtered sequences yield full zero padding. Blank, full, 1x1, 1x30 and 30x1 inputs conserve shape and values. Existing native tests and protected edge replays cover these branches.

Every profile uses its own seed/profile RNG. All six demo and four query profiles are constructed before slicing. Settings never enter input sampling, and every profile has a distinct shape. Supported counts are strict demos 2..6 and queries 1..4.
Down reads the sibling canonical.rkt exactly; its bytes match the unique selected canonical text. Alternate programs are native rule! forms.

The adapter loads the sibling gravity.py by explicit __file__ path; default source uses the same sibling directory. The exporter loads reviewer_support only from its own ancestor tree. Native inventory discovery includes every parametric .py/.rkt/.json source, including gravity.py.

For dense 9x11 and sparse 13x15 crosses, gap indices are at least 4 and at most length-4. This leaves the a,b,a prefix, distinct gray cells on both gap sides, and occupied endpoints intact for every palette/gap draw. The intersecting strands agree on their shared zero. Dense mode makes a nonzero color modal; sparse mode makes zero modal, with more than five values on both witness axes.

audit.py exports through one shared exports directory after protected labels match the native and independent Python implementations. Full/short first-turn identities agree. Every inspected turn has only demonstration input/output pairs and one query input. Programs, settings, seed and runtime provenance occur only in private exports/controller metadata.
